jobVO.jobDesc: Role Purpose**: Build, test, and maintain software solutions. **Responsibilities**: * Write clean, scalable, and efficient code. * Participate in code reviews and sprint planning. * Collaborate with QA and DevOps for CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes). * Debug and optimize applications. Primary Skills: * Expertise in Java 8+, J2EE(JSPs and EJBs), Spring Framework, Hibernate/JPA. * Strong understanding of security (OAuth2, JWT, SSO). * Experience with REST/SOAP web services. * Strong database knowledge (Maria DB/Oracle/MySQL/Postgres). * Proficiency in HTML, XML, XSD, JSON, JavaScript, Typescript, CSS. Angular 18/20 * Experience with frameworks (Spring Boot, Spring MVC, JPA/Hibernate).* * Eclipse BIRT Report 4.15 (open source) * JBoss Application Server 8.0.7.0 (JDK 17)/Websphere/Weblogic * Tomcat Web Server* * Experience in Linux Shell Scripts * Experience in IBM MQ 9.5/Kafka/RabbitMQ * Eclipse/IntelliJ, Visual Studio Code, Putty, WinScp, Git, Jenkins, Postman/SoapUI, Maven/Gradle * ELK Stack/Splunk Secondary Skills: Azure/AWS/Google Cloud. Websphere, experience in Angular version upgrade. Experience in Banking Domain Years of Experience: 8+
